ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio. Approximately 30% high-intensity (white) pixels localized to the distal lateral lobes and 70% low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels across the central body and peduncle connection.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant white contiguous patch on the left lobe tip extending toward the center with heavy punctate black mottling at the interior boundary. Narrower white patch on the distal right lobe tip with diffuse mottling along the ventral trailing edge.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central notch with a measured angle of approximately 85-90 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular trailing edge characterized by high-frequency, small-amplitude serrations. Notable larger peaks and valleys present on the inner-half of the left lobe and the outer-third of the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex trajectory from the median notch to the fluke tips, following a slight sinusoidal curve along the trailing edge boundary.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dark punctate pixel clusters (mottling) scattered within the white lateral fields, particularly concentrated on the leading edge of the left lobe white patch.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Two prominent, vertically oriented, high-contrast parallel linear marks (white on black) located in the lower-central region of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Distinct linear rake marks on the left lobe; irregular jagged indentation/trauma on the terminal right tip of the fluke.
